author: Quinn (@qa)
notes: Preparation only. No model call, no test, no build was run to produce this file.

classes: P = expected to complete end to end (PASSED, no clarification); F = intended failure the system must report as FAILED (never PASSED); N = expected refusal or clarification (UNSUPPORTED or CLARIFICATION), never a published plan.

sourceStatus values: EXISTS (file read in this session), PARTIAL (a close asset exists, adaptation needed), MISSING_LOCAL (must be written, no external needed to write it), EXTERNAL (cannot be built from the repo).
Every case needs ED-01 (gateway), the deployed stack and budget admission to RUN. 'externals' below lists only what is needed in addition to those, to build or to judge the case.

The 13 ported case step texts and fixture pages are NOT in the repository (see gaps G-1); classes for C01..C13 are inferred from docs/stories/UI-STUDIO-VALIDATION-20261004/benchmark/{results.jsonl,summary.json}.

counts.gateDenominatorProposed: class P only: 19 x 3 = 57 runs; >= 90 percent means >= 52 completions (max 5 failed); 51/57 = 89.5 percent fails
counts.gateDenominatorWithoutStagingItems: 17 x 3 = 51 runs; >= 46 (max 5 failed); a PARTIAL result, never a gate pass, because AC-7(b) staging stays unrun

protocolItems.text: One token-free guided Run submits once; finalization adds zero receipts; two later runs reuse the artifact.
protocolItems.needs: deployed stack; receipts counter on the fixture (/receipt exists)

protocolItems.text: Replay stability: >= 98 percent completion over 100 stable-fixture replays with identical artifact hash.
protocolItems.needs: a published artifact from a real-model learn (or an explicit statement that the artifact came from the fixture provider); replay is model-free so it adds no provider spend; 100 replays x real Chromium is a long run (not measured)

hardGateInstrumentation.falsePass: an independent outcome oracle per case (fixture receipts or domain events), never the model's or the runner's own PASSED. Present locally for C04, D1, D3, incremental-*; MUST be added for every MISSING_LOCAL page
hardGateInstrumentation.secretOrPiiLeak: scan of all text outputs and actual gateway bytes for the OBS-007 secret canary and the authored non-secret positive canary (INPUT-POLICY-01 A)
